'''Castell''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The homeworld of the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]], Castell was a major foundry planet for the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]].

==Description==
Castell was located on the edge of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region near the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|111|Castell}}</ref> It was a heavily industrialized [[Factory world/Legends|foundry world]]<ref name="DA">''[[Desperate Allies]]''</ref> located along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]].<ref name="TEA" /> Castell was the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="UAA" /><ref name="NEGAS" />

==History==
===Before the Republic===
Castell was reached by other [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] during the early blazing of the Core Worlds and Colonies between [[27,500 BBY]] and [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]]. Having begun experimentation with the [[Tumbledrive/Legends|tumble hyperdrive]] during the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire's]] reign over parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the [[Gossam Courivers/Legends|Gossam Courivers]] were able to leave Castell and colonize planets such as [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] circa [[27,000 BBY/Legends|27,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was born out of the Core Worlds, Castell joined the rapidly expanding government sometime before [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Old Republic era===
During the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], Castell supported [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />

While the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] kept the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in suspense, the [[Corruption (episode)|corrupt]] authorities of Castell confiscated 'dangerous objects' from inhabitants and shipped the trinkets to other [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|It's For Their Own Good}}</ref>

In the course of the [[New Sith Wars]], the planet was the site of a [[Battle of Castell|battle]] won by the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the latter half of the [[Golden Age of the Old Republic|Republic's Golden Age]] Castell fell into a decades-long depression, only to find an ally in the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]]. Upon the Guild's intervention, the war and slaughter brought about by starvation and economic crisis ended abruptly as the Guild swept in and funneled money into the economy by buying much of the world. In exchange, many Gossams worked as indentured servants for a portion of their life in order to maintain ownership of their property. One such Gossam was the young, corporate-minded [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]], who rose through the corporate world to become Chief of Property Resources. As Mai became more and more prolific in her career, she managed to repurchase the entire planet from the Commerce Guild and lead her people to prosper. In return for her work, Mai raised rents on the world and demanded that her people give her tribute in thanks for gaining back the planet's independence from the Guild.<ref name="NEGAS" />

The production lines of Castell were a source of wealth and influence for the Gossams even if their exploitative indenture system kept the workers from receiving direct benefit. Castell produced virtually everything, including luxury goods, [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]], and even advanced [[Starship/Legends|starship]] components.<ref name="DA" />

===Separatism===
{{Quote|The General claims the fall of our homeworld was part of Dooku's plan. The Commerce Guild is expendable, it would seem.|Presidente [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]]|<ref name="RoF">''[[Reversal of Fortune]]''</ref>}}
True independence never came, however, as Mai was named Presidente of the Commerce Guild and Castell remained one of its largest powerhouses. Mai would eventually lead her people away from the Republic during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], pledging the Commerce Guild's clandestine funding in exchange for a place on the [[Separatist Council/Legends|governing Council]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> While creating an elite group of [[Gossam Commandos/Legends|Gossam Commandos]], Mai and the other Separatists incited the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a bloody war of separatism, against the Republic.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> As Castell was surrounded by Republic space, the region was patrolled by the [[Third Mid Rim Army|3rd Sector Army]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Castell remained under Separatist control until at least the beginning of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> However, the planet eventually [[Capture of Castell/Legends|fell]] to Republic forces near the the end of the war,<ref name="TCSWE" /> much to Presidente Mai's dismay.<ref name="RoF" /> As a result, many Gossam refugees fled to Felucia.<ref name="TCSWE" /> Retreating to Felucia and denounced by her people, Mai was reassured by her superior, [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] that the loss of her homeworld was all apart of his master plan.<ref name="RoF" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], following Presidente Mai's [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|execution]] along with the rest of the Separatist Council on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the war ended and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arose from the ashes of the Republic.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref>

===Later history===
Following the fall of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, the Commerce Guild was disbanded and its remaining holdings were absorbed by the Galactic Empire.<ref name="TNEGtD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'', p. XVIII</ref> Because of their former allegiances, the Gossams of Castell were targeted by the Empire for [[Slaver/Legends|enslavement]], and the factories of the world were repurposed to manufacture military goods for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]],<ref name="NEGAS" /> including the munitions and other tools of conquest that keep Castell oppressed. The indenture experienced in the years prior to the occupation paled in comparison to the grinding slave labor Imperial overseers then demanded.<ref name="DA" />

Undoing any of the meager good that Shu Mai and the Commerce Guild had managed to achieve, Castell spiraled back into economic turmoil under the Empire and was unable to supply many soldiers to the fledgling [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], though many expressed support for the group. Castell was eventually freed of the Imperial rule after the Rebel Alliance emerged victorious over the Empire.<ref name="NEGAS" />

However, by the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the planet was still struggling to recover despite their newfound independence.<ref name="NEGAS" /> By [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the Core Worlds and Colonies fell to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] and the Castell system was [[Battle of the Castell system|conquered]] by the invaders.<ref name="TEA" />

As of [[137 ABY]], the Castell system fell within the area controlled by the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]] of [[Darth Krayt]].<ref name="TEA" />
